name: Nahor
title: Terah's father and Abraham's great-grandfather
summary: Nahor was the son of Serug and the father of Terah, who in turn became the father of Abraham. He is one of the patriarchs in the lineage from Shem to Abraham and lived 148 years according to the biblical genealogy.

keyEvents.title: Born as the son of Serug
keyEvents.description: Nahor was born when his father Serug was 30 years old, continuing the lineage from Shem through the patriarchs.

keyEvents.title: Father of Terah
keyEvents.description: When Nahor was 29 years old, he had a son named Terah, who later became the father of Abraham, the father of faith.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Jesus' genealogy
keyEvents.description: Nahor is mentioned in the Gospel of Luke as part of Jesus' family tree, showing Jesus' ancestry back to Adam.
